command_center._note: Wade memo 10/1 12:11 PM. Two parts: the cockpit (where work is instructed, in Claude on the Swing Bays Mac) and the dashboard (one private web address, phone or laptop, updated as things happen). The sample numbers below are placeholders shown as 'Sample' on the page; they are not real.
command_center.cockpit: On the Swing Bays Mac, in Claude. This is where the work is instructed from: schedule the month's posts, change what the AI says on the phone, add a store, ask for the numbers. Colter, Dustin or Brenna sits here.
command_center.dashboard: One private web address, open it on your phone or laptop. It updates as things happen, so you see how the business is running without asking anyone.
dashboard_shows: The post calendar for every store, a calendar view like the one Kerzie AI runs its own on
Calls the AI answered and handled
DMs received across Instagram and Facebook
Club repairs in the queue and done
New contacts in the customer record

money_view.name: Money view
money_view.what: A read-only connection to QuickBooks or Square, added to the dashboard: money in, money out, revenue and new members.
money_view.who: Visible only to the people Dustin chooses, for example Dustin and Brenna.
money_view.promise: We never move, change, or touch your money. It is a view, nothing more.
money_view.price: Quoted if you want it. Not included in the prices above.
